feature: Private account shared customer profile autosave
coverage: Legacy and guest data import without replacing existing cloud profiles
Manual document overrides and frozen submission snapshots
Offline retry, delayed acknowledgements, two-tab journals and explicit conflict choices
Arabic and English UI, keyboard focus and mobile layout
boundaries: Account mutation tests used isolated local PHP and synthetic users; no test submissions or user-account edits on production.
Guest drafts and document-specific unfinished edits remain browser-local. Shared profile fields autosave only while signed in.
Shared autosave excludes signature images. Saved PDF versions remain immutable.
